projects.title: Non-Intrusive Driver Fatigue Detection System
description: Developed a real-time, non-intrusive driver fatigue detection system using computer vision, deep learning, and facial landmark analysis to monitor drowsiness indicators (eye closure, blink frequency, yawning).
Implemented an intelligent alert mechanism providing immediate audio/visual warnings when signs of fatigue are detected, minimizing latency and false warnings.
Built a scalable software architecture utilizing real-time image processing under varying environmental conditions for integration with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).

projects.title: Hirishi Cloud Kitchen Web Platform
description: Designed and developed the responsive frontend for a local food-tech startup, enabling seamless online browsing and ordering.
Built a dynamic user interface using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, implementing user-friendly state-based cart logic and smooth UI transitions.
Collaborated with the client to deploy the production website at hck.hirishi.com, improving digital presence and customer acquisition.

hackathons.title: Rage CAPTCHA
description: Built a gamified multi-level CAPTCHA system integrated with a Survivor Journal app, featuring logic puzzles, deceptive UI interactions, moving targets, and behavior-based human verification.
Contributed to design, implementation, and debugging under strict time constraints; advanced to the final round.
